lfu_cache.brute:
init(capacity):
    capacity = capacity, data = empty dict key -> [value, count, tick], tick = 0
get(key):
    if key not in data: return -1
    tick += 1, data[key].count += 1, data[key].tick = tick
    return data[key].value
put(key, value):
    if capacity == 0: return
    tick += 1
    if key in data: data[key] = [value, count + 1, tick], return
    if size of data == capacity:
        victim = none, victim_rank = none
        for each other key in data:   (scans every key for the rarest, oldest)
            rank = (count of other, tick of other)
            if victim is none or rank < victim_rank: victim = other, victim_rank = rank
        delete victim from data
    data[key] = [value, 1, tick]
lfu_cache.optimal:
init(capacity):
    capacity = capacity, count_of = empty dict key -> use count
    bucket = empty dict count -> ordered dict key -> value (oldest key first), min_count = 0
touch(key):
    count = count_of[key], value = remove key from bucket[count]
    if bucket[count] is now empty:
        delete bucket[count]
        if min_count == count: min_count = count + 1   (the only place the minimum moves up)
    append key -> value at the end of bucket[count + 1] (create it if missing), count_of[key] = count + 1
    return value
get(key):
    if key not in count_of: return -1
    return touch(key)
put(key, value):
    if capacity == 0: return
    if key in count_of: touch(key), bucket[count_of[key]][key] = value, return
    if size of count_of == capacity:
        victim = first key of bucket[min_count]   (oldest of the rarest)
        delete victim from bucket[min_count] and from count_of; delete bucket[min_count] if empty
    append key -> value to bucket[1], count_of[key] = 1, min_count = 1   (a new key is the rarest)

all_oone_data_structure.brute:
init:
    counts = empty dict key -> count
inc(key):
    counts[key] = counts[key] + 1 (0 if missing)
dec(key):
    counts[key] -= 1
    if counts[key] == 0: delete key from counts
getMaxKey:
    best = ""
    for each key in counts:   (scans every key)
        if best == "" or counts[key] > counts[best]: best = key
    return best
getMinKey:
    same scan with <
all_oone_data_structure.optimal:
init:
    head, tail = sentinel buckets linked head <-> tail   (head doubles as the count-0 bucket)
    where = empty dict key -> the bucket holding it
insert_after(node, count): link a new bucket with that count between node and node.next; return it
remove_key(node, key):
    remove key from node.keys; if node is now empty and not head: unlink node   (drop empty buckets right away)
inc(key):
    cur = where[key], or head if key is new; nxt = cur.next
    if nxt is tail or nxt.count != cur.count + 1: nxt = insert_after(cur, cur.count + 1)
    add key to nxt.keys, where[key] = nxt, remove_key(cur, key)
dec(key):
    cur = where[key]
    if cur.count == 1: delete key from where   (count 0: the key disappears)
    else:
        prv = cur.prev
        if prv is head or prv.count != cur.count - 1: prv = insert_after(cur.prev, cur.count - 1)
        add key to prv.keys, where[key] = prv
    remove_key(cur, key)
getMaxKey: return any key of tail.prev ("" when that is head)
getMinKey: return any key of head.next ("" when that is tail)

maximum_frequency_stack.brute:
init:
    items = empty list in push order
push(val):
    append val to items
pop:
    counts = empty dict; for each val in items: counts[val] += 1   (rebuilt from scratch)
    top = the largest count
    i = last index
    while i >= 0:
        if counts[items[i]] == top: remove and return items[i]   (rightmost among the most frequent)
        i -= 1
maximum_frequency_stack.optimal:
init:
    freq = empty dict val -> current frequency
    group = empty dict frequency -> stack of vals that reached it
    maxfreq = 0
push(val):
    freq[val] = freq[val] + 1 (0 if missing), f = freq[val]
    push val onto group[f] (create it if missing)   (val is now the newest value at frequency f)
    maxfreq = max(maxfreq, f)
pop:
    val = pop the top of group[maxfreq]   (most recent among the most frequent)
    if group[maxfreq] is empty: maxfreq -= 1   (counts grow one at a time: that row is non-empty)
    freq[val] -= 1
    return val

dinner_plate_stacks.brute:
init(capacity):
    capacity = capacity, stacks = empty list
push(val):
    for each stack from left to right:   (walks over every full stack, every time)
        if size of stack < capacity: push val onto it, return
    append a new stack [val]
pop:
    while stacks is not empty and the last stack is empty: drop it
    if stacks is empty: return -1
    return pop the last stack
popAtStack(index):
    if index < number of stacks and stacks[index] is not empty: return pop stacks[index]
    return -1
dinner_plate_stacks.optimal:
init(capacity):
    capacity = capacity
    stacks = empty list   (the last stack is never empty)
    open = empty min-heap of indices that MAY have room
push(val):
    while open is not empty:
        i = top of open
        if i < number of stacks and size of stacks[i] < capacity: break
        pop open   (stale: that stack was trimmed away or filled up)
    if open is empty: append a new empty stack, push its index onto open
    i = top of open, push val onto stacks[i]   (the leftmost stack with room)
    if size of stacks[i] == capacity: pop open   (no room left: retire the index)
pop:
    return popAtStack(last index)
popAtStack(index):
    if index is out of range or stacks[index] is empty: return -1
    val = pop stacks[index]
    push index onto open   (a hole opened here)
    while stacks is not empty and the last stack is empty: drop it
    return val

data_stream_as_disjoint_intervals.brute:
init:
    seen = empty set
addNum(value):
    add value to seen
getIntervals:
    out = empty list
    for each value in seen sorted:   (rebuilt from scratch on every call)
        if out is not empty and the last interval ends at value - 1: extend it to value
        else: append [value, value] to out
    return out
data_stream_as_disjoint_intervals.optimal:
init:
    starts = empty sorted list of interval starts
    ends = the matching inclusive ends
addNum(value):
    i = number of starts <= value   (interval i - 1 has the largest start <= value)
    if i > 0 and ends[i - 1] >= value: return   (already inside an interval)
    touch_left = i > 0 and ends[i - 1] == value - 1
    touch_right = i < size of starts and starts[i] == value + 1
    if touch_left and touch_right: ends[i - 1] = ends[i], delete interval i   (bridges a gap of one)
    else if touch_left: ends[i - 1] = value
    else if touch_right: starts[i] = value
    else: insert value into both starts and ends at position i   (a fresh singleton)
getIntervals:
    out = empty list
    for each i: append [starts[i], ends[i]] to out
    return out

range_module.brute:
init:
    points = empty set of tracked integers
addRange(left, right):
    for each x in [left, right): add x to points   (touches every point, not just the two ends)
queryRange(left, right):
    for each x in [left, right):
        if x not in points: return false
    return true
removeRange(left, right):
    for each x in [left, right): remove x from points
range_module.optimal:
init:
    ends = empty sorted list [l0, r0, l1, r1, ...]   (even index opens a tracked block, odd closes it)
addRange(left, right):
    i = index of the first boundary >= left, j = index of the first boundary > right
    new = empty list
    if i is even: append left to new   (left falls in a gap: it opens the merged block)
    if j is even: append right to new   (right falls in a gap: it closes the merged block)
    replace ends[i:j] with new   (every boundary strictly inside is swallowed)
queryRange(left, right):
    i = index of the first boundary > left, j = index of the first boundary >= right
    return i == j and i is odd   (both ends inside the same tracked block)
removeRange(left, right):
    i = index of the first boundary >= left, j = index of the first boundary > right
    new = empty list
    if i is odd: append left to new   (left was inside a block: that block now ends here)
    if j is odd: append right to new   (right was inside a block: a block restarts here)
    replace ends[i:j] with new

range_sum_query_2d_mutable.brute:
init(matrix):
    cells = copy of matrix
update(row, col, val):
    cells[row][col] = val
sumRegion(row1, col1, row2, col2):
    total = 0
    for each r from row1 to row2:   (every cell, every query)
        for each c from col1 to col2:
            total += cells[r][c]
    return total
range_sum_query_2d_mutable.optimal:
lowest_bit(x): return x & -x   (the block size at index x)
init(matrix):
    m, n = dimensions of matrix, vals = copy of matrix   (to turn "set" into "add delta")
    tree = (m + 1) x (n + 1) zeros   (1-indexed: tree[i][j] sums a block ending at (i, j))
    for each cell (r, c): add(r, c, matrix[r][c])
add(r, c, delta):
    i = r + 1
    while i <= m:
        j = c + 1
        while j <= n: tree[i][j] += delta, j += lowest_bit(j)   (next node whose block covers j)
        i += lowest_bit(i)
prefix(r, c):   (sum of the first r rows x first c columns)
    total = 0, i = r
    while i > 0:
        j = c
        while j > 0: total += tree[i][j], j -= lowest_bit(j)   (jump to the block just before)
        i -= lowest_bit(i)
    return total
update(row, col, val): add(row, col, val - vals[row][col]), vals[row][col] = val   (Fenwick wants a delta)
sumRegion(row1, col1, row2, col2):
    whole = prefix(row2 + 1, col2 + 1), above = prefix(row1, col2 + 1), left = prefix(row2 + 1, col1)
    return whole - above - left + prefix(row1, col1)   (the corner was removed twice: add it back once)

    arr = arr
query(left, right, threshold):
    counts = empty dict
    for each i from left to right: counts[arr[i]] += 1   (the whole slice, every time)
    for each value in counts:

    return -1
online_majority_element_in_subarray.optimal:
init(arr):
    arr = arr
    positions = dict value -> its indices in increasing order
    rng = seeded random generator
count_in_range(value, left, right):
    idx = positions[value]
    return (number of idx <= right) - (number of idx < left)   (two binary searches)
query(left, right, threshold):
    repeat 20 times:   (a majority is missed by one sample with probability < 1/2)
        value = arr[random index in [left, right]]
        if count_in_range(value, left, right) >= threshold: return value
    return -1   (20 misses in a row: no majority)

design_movie_rental_system.brute:
init(n, entries):
    items = dict (shop, movie) -> [price, rented = false]
search(movie):
    candidates = (price, shop) of every unrented copy of movie   (every copy in the system, every query)
    sort candidates
    return the shops of the first 5
rent(shop, movie): items[(shop, movie)].rented = true
drop(shop, movie): items[(shop, movie)].rented = false
report:
    candidates = (price, shop, movie) of every rented copy
    sort candidates
    return [shop, movie] of the first 5
design_movie_rental_system.optimal:
init(n, entries):
    price = dict (shop, movie) -> price; version = dict (shop, movie) -> stamp, bumped on every rent / drop
    available = dict movie -> min-heap of (price, shop, movie, stamp); rented = min-heap of the same tuples
    for each (shop, movie, p) in entries: price[(shop, movie)] = p, version = 0, push (p, shop, movie, 0) onto available[movie]
is_alive(item): return version[(item.shop, item.movie)] == item.stamp   (an old stamp means the copy moved heaps)
top5(heap):
    kept = empty list
    while heap is not empty and size of kept < 5:
        item = pop heap
        if is_alive(item): append item to kept   (stale entries fall out here, for good)
    push every kept item back onto heap
    return kept
search(movie):
    if movie not in available: return []
    return the shops of top5(available[movie])
rent(shop, movie):
    version[(shop, movie)] += 1, push (price, shop, movie, new stamp) onto rented   (the copy in available is now stale)
drop(shop, movie):
    version[(shop, movie)] += 1, push (price, shop, movie, new stamp) onto available[movie]   (the copy in rented is now stale)
report: return [shop, movie] of top5(rented)

design_in_memory_file_system.brute:
init:
    entries = dict full path -> content   ("/" present; a directory maps to none)
ensure_dirs(path):
    for each prefix of the path's components: add that directory path to entries if missing
ls(path):
    if entries[path] is a file: return [its last component]
    prefix = path + "/", names = empty list
    for each stored path:   (every stored path, every ls)
        if it starts with prefix and the rest has no "/": append the rest to names   (a direct child)
    return names sorted
mkdir(path): ensure_dirs(path)
addContentToFile(filePath, content):
    ensure_dirs(parent directory of filePath)
    if filePath is not a file yet: entries[filePath] = ""
    entries[filePath] += content
readContentFromFile(filePath): return entries[filePath]
design_in_memory_file_system.optimal:
init:
    root = node with an empty dict name -> child and content none   (none = directory)
walk(path):
    node = root
    for each non-empty component of path split on "/":
        if the component is not a child of node: create it   (creates the missing directories on the way)
        node = that child
    return node
ls(path):
    node = walk(path)
    if node is a file: return [last component of path]
    return node's child names sorted   (the children ARE the listing)
mkdir(path): walk(path)
addContentToFile(filePath, content):
    node = walk(filePath)
    if node.content is none: node.content = ""   (a fresh file)
    node.content += content
readContentFromFile(filePath): return walk(filePath).content

design_skiplist.brute:
init:
    items = empty sorted list
search(target):
    for each value in items: if value == target: return true   (linear scan)
    return false
add(num):
    i = 0
    while i < size of items and items[i] < num: i += 1   (walk to the insertion point)
    insert num at position i   (shifts everything after it)
erase(num):
    for each index i: if items[i] == num: remove it, return true
    return false
design_skiplist.optimal:
init:
    head = sentinel node with MAX_LEVEL forward pointers, level = 1 (rows in use), rng = seeded random generator
random_level:
    height = 1
    while height < MAX_LEVEL and a coin flip lands heads: height += 1   (each extra row halves the nodes)
    return height
path(target):
    update = MAX_LEVEL copies of head, node = head
    for each row i from level - 1 down to 0:
        while node.forward[i] exists and its value < target: node = node.forward[i]   (ride the express lane)
        update[i] = node   (the last node on row i before target)
    return update
search(target):
    node = path(target)[0].forward[0]   (the first node with a value >= target)
    return node exists and node.val == target
add(num):
    update = path(num), height = random_level, level = max(level, height), node = new node(num, height)
    for each row i < height: node.forward[i] = update[i].forward[i], update[i].forward[i] = node   (splice in)
erase(num):
    update = path(num), node = update[0].forward[0]; if node is missing or node.val != num: return false
    for each row i of node: update[i].forward[i] = node.forward[i]
    while level > 1 and the top row is empty: level -= 1
    return true
